parts.name: Axis
parts.description: The ticks, the tick labels and the label of one axis.

props.name: position
props.description: The side of the plot. The default is `bottom`. `top` and `bottom` show the x scale.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the axis, for example the name and the unit of the values.

props.name: tickSize
props.description: The length of a tick line, in pixels. The default is 6.

props.name: tickPadding
props.description: The distance between a tick line and its label, in pixels. The default is 3.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the group of the axis.

dataAttributes.name: data-axis
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the axis. The value is the `position`.

dataAttributes.name: data-axis-line
dataAttributes.description: On the line along the plot.

dataAttributes.name: data-tick
dataAttributes.description: On the group of each tick: its line and its label.

parts.name: Grid
parts.description: The grid lines of one axis, one line at each tick.

props.name: axis
props.description: The axis whose ticks give the lines. The default is `y`: horizontal lines.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the group of the grid.

dataAttributes.name: data-grid
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the lines. The value is the `axis`.
